classification: Independent expectation-domain error; no implementation arithmetic defect
rationale: Pinned decoder takes a signed short and divides by SHRT_MAX without rejecting -32768. The selected scalar decoder is mathematically defined for -32768, even though the encoder and quantizer produce only [-32767,32767]. The harness explicitly documents full-short decode. Testing this raw-domain observation is appropriate and must not be confused with quantizer input policy.
